notes.title: Blackrock v0.5.1.5 – Patchnotes
notes.content: [list][*][p]🟩 [b]Weapon UI overhaul[/b] – weapons are now listed in the HUD, with the active one highlighted by a rounded green frame.[/p][/*][*][p]🕷️ [b]Charon finished[/b] – the terrifying Blackrock Spider (only killable with sniper rifles) is now complete![/p][/*][*][p]🗿 [b]Golem finished[/b] – the massive Crusher Golem (rocket-only kill) is fully implemented with polish and proper sounds.[/p][/*][*][p]🐀 [b]New enemy: Splintrin[/b] – swarms of corrupted Blackrock rats that attack in numbers rather than raw power.[/p][/*][*][p]🎬 [b]Animation fixes[/b] – smoother animations for Charon, Golem Crusher, and Scientists.[/p][/*][*][p]📖 [b]Story 2 progress[/b] – the second story mission (escort-based, short but intense) is almost complete – chaos, explosions, and new enemies await![/p][/*][*][p]👨‍🔬 [b]Escort improvements[/b] – scientist timers/triggers fixed and their movement speed increased for less sluggish pacing.[/p][/*][*][p]🚪 [b]Door timer feedback[/b] – slow-opening doors now display a progress bar: red for long wait, green when almost done, pulsing when plenty of time is left.[/p][/*][*][p]🔊 [b]Sound updates[/b] – optional distance-based sound gain for extra immersion.[/p][/*][*][p]🐞 [b]Bugfix[/b] – fixed a crash when trying to switch weapons while only owning one.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Blackrock – Quick Patch Notes
notes.content: [list][*][p]Fixed a bug where story intro textboxes got disabled and never reactivated (oops 🙃).[/p][/*][*][p]The Golem finally makes proper sounds instead of placeholders! (His attack is still placeholder, but that’s top of the list for the next patch).[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Story 2 couldn’t be completed.[/p][/*][*][p]Scientists in escort missions are now faster – because slow NPCs are just trash 🚀.[/p][/*][*][p]Blackrocks in Story 2 got a slight buff… can’t let things get boring 😉.[/p][/*][*][p]Added the proper Story 2 Music.[/p][/*][/list][p]Love yall,[/p][p]Joe[/p]

notes.title: Blackrock v0.5.1.3 – Patch Notes
notes.content:
[list][*][p][b]New Enemy: Golem[/b]
Slow, tanky as hell, and only killable with rockets. Have fun blasting away![/p][/*][*][p][b]Story Level 2 – Progress[/b]
Made a big step forward, but still far from finished. The level can’t be fully completed yet, but as always you get a transparent look into the development process.
👉 It’s an [b]escort mission[/b], but don’t worry: long escorts are boring – this one is short, but packed with nonstop explosions and chaos. 💥[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Blackrock Design[/b]
Revamped look that hits harder – also applied to the battlefields.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bugfixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Couldn’t exit story missions after dying → fixed.[/p][/*][*][p]Couldn’t pause story missions after dying → fixed.[/p][/*][*][p]Keycards in Mission 1 could be farmed infinitely (funny, but clearance 20 didn’t open anything 😅) → fixed.[/p][/*][*][p]Crash in Story Mission 2 if all scientists died → fixed.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Quality of Life[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added a small story disclaimer so you don’t get thrown back to the main menu too abruptly.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Community[/b][/p][list][*][p]Discord server is in progress – should be ready in about a week. 😉[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p]👉 See you in the next update![/p]

notes.title: Blackrock v0.5.1.3 – Patch Notes
notes.content: [list][*][p][b]Stoneworms and Scorps[/b] should now properly attack instead of only trapping their enemies.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Massive preparations[/b] underway for [b]Story Level 2[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Tons of [b]small tweaks[/b] across enemies and weapons to improve overall balance.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Squad panel expanded[/b] to display more info on who is currently following or holding position (better squad placement overview).[/p][/*][/list]

notes.content: [list][*][p]Added a [b]story disclaimer[/b] at the end of the first preview level[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a [b]player invulnerability bug[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Corrected [b]wall collision[/b] issues in Story 1[/p][/*][*][p]Polished and corrected [b]tutorial texts[/b][/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Blackrock V0.5.1.0 – Patch Notes
notes.content: [h3]🔫 Gameplay & Content[/h3][list][*][p]Complete weapon system overhaul:[/p][list][*][p]Fixed loadout instead of procedural randomness.[/p][/*][*][p]Weapons can now be cycled via mouse wheel or stick press.[/p][/*][*][p]Available weapons: [b]Standard MG, Minigun, Sniper Rifle, Rocket Launcher[/b] (more – including unconventional ones – are planned).[/p][/*][*][p]Added recoil, smoke and rumble effects for all weapons.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Squad members now have [b]specialized weapons[/b] fitting their role — positioning and strategy become more important.[/p][/*][*][p]Crusher boss now [b]uses its laser attack[/b] and spawns additional enemies. (Difficulty under observation, might be tuned later.)[/p][/*][*][p]Berserkers trigger [b]screenshake[/b] when enraged. [i](If the community prefers, future updates may include options to reduce or disable such effects.)[/i][/p][/*][/list][h3]🛠 Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed grenade throw direction when aiming with mouse.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed grenade charge speed — power now grows at the intended rate.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Zulu’s walking sprite displaying incorrectly.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the player sometimes took damage instead of a squad member.[/p][/*][/list][h3]⚡ Performance[/h3][list][*][p]Code improvements should noticeably increase performance, especially on older systems.[/p][/*][*][p]Squad AI optimized — both smarter and lighter on resources.[/p][/*][/list][h3]🏗 Development[/h3][list][*][p]Project structure has been reorganized for [b]faster content development[/b] in upcoming updates.[/p][/*][/list][h3]🔮 Coming Soon[/h3][list][*][p]A smaller update will follow next week.[/p][/*][*][p]Reason: I’m also setting up the official [b]Cavedwarf Studios Discord server[/b] 🎉 so the community has a place to gather, chat and share feedback.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.content: [list][*][p]Added a big supporter to the credits (thank you! 🙌)[/p][/*][*][p]The Crusher now has a proper death animation[/p][/*][*][p]After the final door... you go where you belong: back to the main menu[/p][/*][*][p]Nerfed the Crusher a lot. Why? Because reasons :)[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Blackrock V0.5.0.3 – Patch Notes
notes.content:
[p][b]🚀 Story Improvements[/b][/p][list][*][p]Grenades in the story mode have been improved!
You now get [b]ammo[/b] for them, and [b]collectible grenade pickups[/b] have been added.
Don’t be afraid to use them anymore – they’re not a one-time treat![/p][/*][/list][p][b]🔐 Keycard Doors in Level 1[/b][/p][list][*][p]In the first story level, doors now [b]block your path[/b] if you haven’t found the [b]corresponding keycard[/b]. No more rushing through unprepared![/p][/*][/list][p][b]💥 The Crusher Appears[/b][/p][list][*][p]The [b]Crusher[/b] has made its debut in the first story level!
He’s [b]not finished yet[/b], but already a menace. Your [b]feedback is crucial[/b] here.
[i](Personally, I think he's a bit too hard... borderline unfair. Expect changes!)[/i][/p][/*][/list][p][b]💀 Karma Battle Tweak[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]No more shard potions[/b] in Karma Battles – they’re useless there anyway.
Nothing helps against [b]Bobby’s gang[/b]… except [b]death[/b]. :)[/p][/*][/list][p][b]🔫 Weapon System Overhaul (In Progress)[/b][/p][list][*][p]We’re scrapping the old [b]random weapon system[/b]. It just wasn’t fun.
Instead, we’re introducing a [b]selectable arsenal[/b]:
Machine guns, sniper rifles, rocket launchers – and more!
You’ll be able to [b]switch weapons on the fly[/b] to adapt to the situation. Stay tuned![/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Blackrock – Quickpatch 0.5.0.2
notes.content: [list][*][p]🕵️‍♂️ [b]Karma room properly hidden[/b]: Fixed a bug that caused the Karma room to show up without triggering the Easter egg. Not anymore, sneaky one. 😏[/p][/*][*][p]💥 [b]Story death crash fixed[/b]: The game no longer crashes when dying in the story or Karma room. You'll now be sent back to the main menu with dignity.[/p][/*][*][p]🧹 [b]Delete now wipes Karma too[/b]: Resetting story progress now also clears the Karma trigger from the INI. Fresh starts for clean conscience![/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Blackrock – Patchnotes | Experimental Story Seeds & Smarter Squads
notes.content:
[p]🧪 [b]Experimental Content[/b][/p][p]First story elements have made their way into the game – but they’re [i]not[/i] just sitting in plain sight.
Those who click the [b]Story button[/b]... very, very often... might discover something. 😉[/p][p]A secret place called the [b]Karma Room[/b] has also been added. What does it mean? Nobody knows for sure – but it definitely feels... different.
[i](Note: Story & Karma are experimental and will be expanded. You can always return to the main menu using ESC or SELECT.)[/i][/p][p]I want to share these systems with you, even if they’re not finished yet – that’s why I’m keeping them in, even if hidden.[/p][p]But they’ll never interfere with the current gameplay experience. If that ever becomes a risk, I’ll hold experimental features back until they’re ready.[/p][p]🧠 [b]Improved Squad AI[/b][/p][p]Your companions (Beta, Lambda, Zulu) now follow you automatically at a smart distance and attack enemies once they’re in range [i]and[/i] visible.[/p][p]You can toggle follow behavior per unit using:[/p][list][*][p](A/B/Y) on [b]Xbox[/b][/p][/*][*][p](Cross/Circle/Triangle) on [b]PlayStation[/b][/p][/*][*][p](Y/X/C) on [b]Keyboard[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]Targeting system reworked: attacks are now smarter and respect line of sight.[/p][p]🔥 [b]Combat, Effects & Performance[/b][/p][p]Target lines have been visually reworked for improved clarity.[/p][p]Generator particle effects optimized – fewer FPS drops, more [i]kaboom[/i].[/p][p]Attack animations and hit timing cleaned up (no more sprite flickering).[/p][p]🚀 [b]Pathfinding & Movement[/b][/p][p]New pathfinding logic for squad AI: less lag, more brain.[/p][p]Squad units adjust their spacing to the player and navigate efficiently – even through the darker story levels.[/p][p]No more endless recalculations – delay logic has been added.[/p][p]🎯 [b]Spawns & Enemies[/b][/p][p]Enemy caps in the Karma Room now scale with your [b]survival time[/b] – it won’t get out of hand.
...Unless you survive too long 😅[/p][p]Balancing will take more time and testing – I appreciate your patience while I fine-tune the madness.[/p][p]Spawn logic and intervals have been reworked for a more even flow of action.[/p][p]🎨 [b]Visuals & UI[/b][/p][p]An [b]epilepsy warning[/b] has been added for rooms with strong flickering effects.
(This includes a tiny Easter egg that may – or may not – lead to the Karma Room.)[/p][p]Light surfaces are now only created when needed. I’ve realized I picked up a bad habit here… but I’m on it.[/p][p]Menu and GUI elements have been refined – especially in Karma and Story levels.[/p][p]🪨 [b]And Else?[/b][/p][p]Meteorites in the Spacetrain level used to be invisible? Not anymore![/p][p]Various smaller fixes and improvements to draw events, visual effects, and debug output.[/p]

notes.title: Patchnotes and preparation for future updates
notes.content: [list][*][p]🧪 A [i]secret[/i] story intro sequence was hidden somewhere in the game. If you find it... well, you’ll know.[/p][/*][*][p]🔊 [i]Acid-Turrets[/i] were yelling too loud – their volume has been turned down to a less aggressive level.[/p][/*][*][p]🎯 The targeting system for both player and turrets has been reworked from the ground up. Easier to maintain, harder to break.[/p][/*][*][p]🫡 [i]Beta, Lambda, and Zulu[/i] joined the squad. Nobody knows which squad, where, or why. They might just be a fever dream.[/p][/*][*][p]🎨 Tons of new sprites added – they’ll be important for the upcoming story parts... or maybe just to look cool.[/p][/*][/list]
